**Fab Shift Log Summary:**

- **Pressure Drift:** Chambers 1, 13, 25, and 37 experienced slight overnight pressure drift, remaining within tolerance.
- **Defects & Maintenance:**
  - Cracked focus ring in etcher 7 caused a killer defect cluster on wafer W-24-0917, lot held.
  - CMP pads replaced on polishers 5, 17, and 29; defect density near line average.
  - Etch uniformity maps show usual edge roll-off.
  - Litho overlay within spec on steppers 8, 20, and 32.
  - Furnace ramp profiles unchanged, wet bench chemistries refreshed on schedule.
  - Handler jams on sorters 11, 23, and 35, no wafers lost.
  - Probe cards 12, 24, and 36 cleaned, contact resistance normal.
- **Alarms & Queues:**
  - Brief vacuum alarms on impl
